Fantasy drama, with Dean Andrews and Joe Absolom (Doc Martin)

event.name: Minder
event.description: Arthur and Terry are hired by two farmers to transport a prize bull, little suspecting they are actually being tricked into stealing it. When their error of judgement become apparent, the duo try to redeem themselves by working out a way to get the animal back. George Cole and Dennis Waterman star

event.name: Benidorm
event.description: Joyce is furious with Sam and Monty after Sammy's disastrous performances in Neptunes, and she soon finds out that Monty has given him a Solana contract. Meanwhile, Doreen jumps the gun by sending Pauline's novel to be published, and Sheron and Billy take a trip down memory lane and spend a day reliving their youth. Elsewhere, Denis and Nigel are increasingly reluctant to arrest Lesley, and Mateo worries about having to go on another concubine cruise with Crystal Hennessy-Vass

event.name: Ashes to Ashes
event.description: A serial arsonist targets sites related to the 1983 general election. After risking his life in a burning building following a quiet word from Keats, Ray gets personally involved in the high-profile investigation - which forces him to face his traumatic past as it becomes clear the tragic events of the Falklands War are driving the firestarter to murder. Fantasy drama, with Dean Andrews and Joe Absolom (Doc Martin)

event.name: The Kenny Everett Video Show
event.description: In the very first episode of his hit series, Kenny brings his unique mix of offbeat humour, music, and visual flair to the screen. With performances from Wings, Bryan Ferry, Bonnie Tyler, the Electric Light Orchestra and the Steve Gibbons Band, plus a stylish dance routine from Hot Gossip. There's even a brief appearance from Elton John and a vintage music moment with Dickie Pride
